findings.quote: We propose the opening of a new phase of international cooperation, bringing together the member state, the agency of United Nation, we say scientific and academic institution, geographer and cartographers, historian, educators, young people, and the innovators shaping the technologies of tomorrow, including artificial intelligence.
findings.rationale: Invites AI innovators into international and UN-linked cooperation on accurate, inclusive cartography, education and representation.

findings.quote: The government also rely on special information and artificial intelligence system increasingly interpret our planet through digital data and cartographic representation.
